Container.Name: fcopy-web
Container.Overview: HTTPS file transfer console with local copies, remote uploads/downloads, saved PCs, history and paused recovery. Persist /config and map only the data folders you want exposed. On first initialization, read the random admin password in the container log or mount a bootstrap password file. No default password. Do not expose directly to the Internet.

Config.Name: HTTPS console
Config.Description: HTTPS only; accept the self-signed certificate after comparing its fingerprint.

Config.Name: Persistent configuration
Config.Description: Accounts, TLS identity, profiles, history, recovery and torrent state. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: Transfer data
Config.Description: Only this mapped directory is available to transfers. Must have suitable nobody/users permissions.
